matchInput: I want to open a restaurant
aliases: I want to start a restaurant
disclaimer: This is a planning outline and cost estimate only. It is not legal, tax, or regulatory advice. Hire an appropriate licensed professional for compliance matters.

steps.title: Hire a graphic designer for the restaurant's logo and brand identity
steps.why: The name and logo get reused on signage, the menu, and social media, so they should come first to avoid re-work.

steps.title: Hire a photographer for food and interior shots
steps.why: Food photo quality directly shapes how customers judge a restaurant online. Shooting after the brand is set means one shoot covers menu and marketing.

steps.title: Hire a web developer for a basic site with menu and location
steps.why: A simple website with the menu, hours, and location helps customers find you and decide to visit.

steps.title: Hire a social media manager for Facebook and Instagram
steps.why: Regular posting of the opening, new menu items, and promotions needs a monthly content plan.

steps.title: Engage a company-registration specialist for legal setup
steps.why: Registration and licensing paperwork should be handled with an appropriate professional. This step names the professional type only — it is not advice.
